notes.title: [Update] September 24th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Home Town has gotten a brand-new makeover!
Discover a special hometown where you can build your very own precious Farm.

▶ Your very own My Farm!
Your very own garden has appeared in your front yard.
Plant and harvest various Crops, and enjoy a rewarding Farm Life.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/666e0fffe59567639c667cd6f70c3d1149cb38d6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a488301a4c29b0db55e4bcf6c5764db9a5070cb1.jpg

When you’re in the same Farm with friends, Crop selling prices get a bonus. 
You can also gift harvested Crops to your friends.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f6588310fb1102bf92059c2f02642666e914401c.png

▶ A Day at the Farm Event
Events will be held to help you adapt to farming. 
Complete the Event Missions and build up your Farm. 
Depending on your progress, you can earn the ‘Sapling Farmer Costume’ and ‘Choco Mottled Cow.’
※ A Day at the Farm Event Missions can be completed for 21 days starting from your first login after the update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/86e2f051b4c106446d7377b0591f9f1a59b1dab6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7684178c40981691dc870b6001cb0a28e80939a7.png

▶ Healthy Growth Attendance
A new attendance board has been added! Simply log in for 14 days to get the ‘Exceptional Sprinkler,’ which helps your Crops grow, and a ‘Seed Pack Vol. 1’ full of different Seeds.
You can claim attendance rewards by stamping at the ‘Event’ icon on the top right of the game screen.
※ The Healthy Growth Attendance event runs for 21 days from when you first claim a reward.
※ Note: If you don’t stamp the reward, you won’t be able to claim it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/2928ef7605b9e3beccd54ce7cf1bff94dade94c3.png

▶ Introducing the Star Minime Carrier!
The Star Minime Carrier has been added, letting your Minime join you in various activities.
Now you don’t need to place your Minime on the cold ground while fishing, riding a Vehicle, Mining, or using Critter! 
Check out the new Star Minime Carrier at the Minime Center.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/26ae3520bd7831daac9075f2a40c03a9706d67b1.png

▶ Show Affection to Minimes
Show Affection to other players’ Minimes.
Loved Minimes get a small boost in random Stats.
※ Stat boosts apply only up to a certain number of times per day, and Minime EXP does not increase.

▶ Moo Moo~ Pudgy Cow Draw!
New friends have arrived to wake the farm in the morning—‘Pudgy Cow’ is here!
Travel all around Kaia Island with Pudgy Cow!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/fdaa83889c05d870eed018c4882184e8e682584e.png

▶ Shining Letters, Hangeul Day!
‘Sejong the Great’ and the ‘Hangeul Lovers Member’ NPCs will appear in the plaza.
Check out special costumes engraved with beautiful Hangeul and Taegukgi items!
※ Available from October 3, 2025, 00:00 - October 10, 2025, 12:00 AM (UTC).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f797caef1db04dd2a5c612d68461242d67d44664.png

- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.
 
※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.

notes.title: [Update] April 28th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
The beautiful Dreamland is being tainted by nightmares!
Defeat the Nightmare Monsters and restore Dreamland to its original form!

▶ Defeat the Nightmare Monsters!
Receive the 'Dream Gun Weapon' from Dreamy, defeat the Nightmare Monsters, and save Dreamland from being consumed by nightmares!
Each time you defeat a monster, you can obtain 'Essence of Nightmares.' Complete the Nightmare Record Mission by defeating monsters! You can also obtain the 'Bed Consumed by Nightmares' mount, where terrifying nightmare hands emerge.
※ The 'Essence of Nightmares' you collect can be used in the mini-game 'Gather Fragments of Memory.'
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/00d50cc21922cbf0a764ef1fe6bbd3d6b9d4e46e.png

▶ Mini-game 'Gather Fragments of Memory'
Use the 'Essence of Nightmares' to open the Nightmare Drawer and collect 'Fragments of Memory' in this mini-game, available only during the Nightmare event!
The Nightmare Drawer consists of 8 rows, and you can open one of the 4 drawers in each row.
If you open a drawer with a Fragments of Memory, you can move to the next row. If you open an empty drawer, the mini-game ends, and you will collect the Fragments of Memory you have opened so far. Be careful when choosing, as the number of drawers with Fragments of Memory decreases as you go higher!
※ The 'Essence of Nightmares' can be collected until May 21, 2025, before maintenance.
※ The 'Gather Fragments of Memory' mini-game is available until May 23, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
※ By collecting Fragments of Memory, you can obtain the 'Gothic Fluffy Hair' and the 'Nightmare Girl Dress.'
※ If you have a large number of 'Essence of Nightmares,' you can set the multiplier up to 100x, allowing you to collect Fragments of Memory in bulk based on the multiplier.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7c186f35b2a46961aaa6c16a0c14e0b0154c0c72.png

▶ Dreamland Workshop – Nightmare Edition!
Craft new furniture with the 'Essence of Nightmares' obtained from defeating Nightmare Monsters.
Come and meet gothic-style furniture and the adorable 'Nightmare Sheep' at Dreamland Workshop!

# You can also craft existing Dreamland Workshop furniture and Sheep Eggs.
※ Capture the Nightmare Fish and Nightmare Insects from Dreamland and exchange them for 'Dreamland Coins' with 'Siestalina' and 'Slumbert.'
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/ca2b625a2486b16b4064a463a6fec0f7743e4882.png

▶ Traces of Nightmares Attendance
An attendance event has begun where you can receive special rewards by attending for 7 days.
Receive the 'Mask of Nightmares' and 'Guiding Candle' rewards and escape from the nightmares!
※ Even if you log into the game, you cannot receive rewards unless you stamp your attendance. Be sure to touch the 'Event' icon in the top-right corner of the game screen to collect your rewards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/fff6cecb8694f733c63bf1f5dcee145d6de13d43.png

▶ Nightmare? That's Me, Queen of the Night Draw!
A new Queen of the Night Draw, colored by nightmares, has been added.
Gift monsters the 'Scepter of the Night' weapon, infused with the Queen's power, and send them into nightmares!
※ An event-themed draw is available, where you can obtain 'Special Rewards' based on your draw count.
However, special reward points will not accumulate if the themed draw was performed through special offers such as daily specials.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/6987842ccc3a5b8e880a431b9bfd79a49b2b6594.png

▶ Set a Fish Trap to Catch Fish!
Did you know you can set a fish trap in places like the Plaza, Resort, and Dreamland on Kaia Island?
Find the [Fish Trap] right now on your [Phone]!
The time and quantity of fish you can catch depend on the trap size, and you can increase the chances of catching rare fish by using bait.
※ Fish traps are unlocked after catching 10 fish with fishing.
※ Only one fish trap can be set, but the number of traps that can be installed increases once you reach 50 entries in the Fish Book.
※ You can set an additional fish trap when activating Plus Membership.
※ Traps that are set can be retrieved at any time, and you can only collect the fish caught at the time of retrieval.
※ You can complete the installation of a fish trap immediately by using gems.
※ The bait used and the trap are consumed immediately upon installation.
※ Fish traps set in Dreamland will be discarded when the Dreamland event ends, so don't forget to retrieve them!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/69322e70f2621539af3d7cc5b2311afa591ae820.png

▶ New Card Collection 'Our Episode'
A new card collection event featuring episodes from the NPCs of Kaia Island begins!
Collect cards and receive generous rewards, including the 'Top Citizen' name tag and 'Play Together Hot Air Balloon'!
※ When the new card collection event starts, all previously collected card information will be reset.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7c1210996edc133290161cfbfc8527c790f60add.png

▶ Report Improvements
No to illegal programs! No to bad manners! Please report any disruptive residents who disturb Kaia Island! The reporting system has been improved to make reporting easier and more efficient!
If you spot a bad resident, be sure to use the newly revamped reporting system!

# Reporting Illegal Programs
 1. Report the subject.
 2. Select the illegal program category.
 3. Select and submit the detailed information.

# Reporting Bad Manners
 1. Report the subject. 
 2. Select the bad manners category.
 3. Select and submit the detailed information.

# Reporting Inappropriate Text
 1. Find the subject or inappropriate text (message, guestbook, etc.)
 2. Select the subcategory
※ You only need to select the subcategory (nickname, pet name, etc.) when selecting a subject.
 3. Select and submit the detailed information.

※ Irresponsible reporting may cause delays in processing. If it continues, it may be considered as 'Bad behavior: Actions that hinder or interfere with the normal operation of the game's management,' and access may be restricted.
For game errors, inquiries, or suggestions, please use the customer support center.

▶ Other Updates and Changes
- Nicknames (in-game names) of accounts with no login activity since July 1, 2021, will be reset.
- The PlayBoo booth will move next to the concert hall.
- The price of Pink Megalodon and Dozy Doctor Fish will be adjusted:
 : Pink Megalodon 720 Stars → 1,080 Stars
 : Crowned Pink Megalodon 2,160 Stars → 3,240 Stars
 : Dozy Doctor Fish 720 Stars → 320 Stars
 : Crowned Dozy Doctor Fish 2,160 Stars → 960 Stars
- To allow more Citizens to enjoy special moments in Dreamland, the Dreamland event period will be extended.
- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.
 
※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.
 
We hope your time on Kaia Island is enjoyable.
Thank you.
